verdict.rationale: Plausible's docs list a 'User journeys' feature to 'explore the paths visitors take on your site', and the homepage says you can 'explore the paths visitors actually take to discover flows you didn't predict' alongside fixed-step funnels. Older community comments say Plausible lacked user-flow tracking. These read as earlier statements of absence, not hands-on failures of the documented feature, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: evidence of anchoring paths to a key event (before/after views), in-depth documentation of how journeys work, and independent hands-on corroboration of the journeys feature.
